description.value: The Broken Seal is a waterfront bar and restaurant in Squamish, situated on the waterfront side of a building facing Howe Sound and the Stawamus Chief. It serves an eclectic Japanese-French-Peruvian small plates menu alongside a craft cocktail program led by an award-winning bar team, using locally sourced ingredients from the Sea to Sky corridor. With capacity for up to 80 guests and a seasonal menu that rotates twice a year, it bills itself as Squamish's new favourite waterfront hangout.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (6 spaces) at 50m; stands (2 spaces) at 94m; stands (2 spaces) at 96m. Total: 10 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at thebrokenseal.ca is live and active, confirming a real, open waterfront bar and restaurant at 38038 Loggers Lane, Squamish — matching the OSM address exactly. The site announces a Summer 2026 menu launch, establishing it as currently operational. No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, takeout, or any other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site, so all those fields are null.
